scope.gp: exact, fixed hyperparameters; finite evaluation grid
scope.greedy: open-loop nominal-information route; assumes all scheduled samples succeed

scope.safety: sampled piecewise-linear motion checked by common displacement backtracking
scope.usv: turn-rate-limited kinematic unicycle; zero-speed yaw allowed; no hydrodynamics
